svg.title: United States class recognition drawing
svg.desc: Original WNT1922 United States class recognition illustration. Port profile and deck plan share one hull length and equipment stations. Hull dimensions follow the catalog. Fitted catalog main battery: 15 barrels. Internal submarine tubes are not depicted as exposed deck mounts.
